mapper.select: SELECT o.*, p.title as product_title, p.images as product_image, bu.username as buyer_name, su.username as seller_name FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN t_user bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.id LEFT JOIN t_user su ON o.seller_id = su.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, product_id, buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, status, buyer_remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{buyerRemark})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status}, buyer_remark = #{buyerRemark} WHERE id = #{id}
